title: SafeFUME™ 360 Automatic Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers
meta_title: SafeFUME 360 Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chambers for Forensic Evidence Processing
meta_description: The SafeFUME 360 is an advanced cyanoacrylate fuming chamber that creates a safe work environment for developing latent prints from non-porous surfaces. Available in multiple sizes from benchtop to walk-in.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, forensic equipment, latent print development, crime scene investigation, law enforcement
short_description: The SafeFUME™ 360 is used to develop latent prints from non-porous surfaces in a controlled and safe environment. Choose from small benchtop units to larger walk-in chambers.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the SafeFUME 360 cyanoacrylate fuming chamber creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Optional side and rear windows provide a 360° view of the development process. Choose from multiple sizes, from bench top to floor standing, including multi-chamber cabinets. Caster wheels are standard on all models except the bench top series, and an optional UV lamp provides decontamination. Evidence is easily positioned inside the chamber using the adjustable hanging rods. The automated system controls the hot plate, cabinet humidity, door lock, internal circulation fan, and purge cycle. The recirculatory design requires no ducting for setup, and cyanoacrylate vapors are filtered by a special carbon filter to ensure no dangerous substances are exhausted into the atmosphere.
seo_content: The SafeFUME 360 cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is an essential tool for state and federal crime laboratories, crime scene investigation teams, law enforcement agencies, medical examiners' programs, and criminal justice education facilities. Its advanced features and comprehensive safety systems make it the premier choice for developing latent prints from non-porous surfaces.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.
